facts.business: Paluck Technologies Limited is a diversified engineering services and infrastructure support company operating across Automobile & Engineering Services, Construction Equipment Rental, and Telecom Engineering Services, providing concrete transportation, infrastructure equipment rental, RMC plant setup, telecom site O&M, and authorized OEM servicing for generators, commercial vehicles, and two-wheelers.
key_risks: Top 10 customers contributed ~45-65% of revenue; top 1 customer ~8-23% — concentration risk
Dependence on limited number of customers and suppliers
Operations centered in Delhi-NCR/Haryana and a few northern/central states, limiting geographic diversification
Revenue tied to infrastructure/construction and telecom capex cycles sensitive to government spending, interest rates, and economic slowdowns
Delays and cost overruns from land acquisition, statutory approvals, labor unrest, or weather on fixed-price contracts
Exposure to Indian economic conditions, interest rate/inflation swings, and global shocks affecting commodity/energy prices
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during FY 2025-26 were at arm's length and in the ordinary course of business; no materially significant transactions with promoters, directors, KMPs, or designated persons that may conflict with company interest. Details disclosed in Form AOC-2 (Annexure D) and notes to financial statements per AS-18.
